source.name: coinbase_btc_usd_spot
source.justification: A trading /review on this platform often cites a last price as a stated fact. Coinbase's public spot is an independent HTTPS source (not Hyperliquid, not Binance — Binance is geo-blocked from this box). Authenticating THAT response is the Step-3 gap: prove the cited print came from api.coinbase.com, then let /review judge the reasoning.
